'Usual snack bags' resolved to MG-KT-003 (Reusable Snack Bags 30ct) based on 4 of 5 historical orders (most recently ORD-0979). verdict.explanation: All checks pass. Retailer resolved to RET-HARBOR (Harbor Wholesale). 'Usual snack bags' confidently matched to MG-KT-003 based on order history (4/5 past orders). 'Bamboo shelf liner' matched to MG-ST-003 (Bamboo Shelf Liner 8ft), the sole bamboo-named storage SKU in the catalog and on the contract price list — confidence is slightly discounted here as the customer called it 'new' and this SKU has appeared in prior orders (ORD-0962), which may warrant a human double-check. No PO number was given.
